title: Chapter 168 Void Son
content:
Chapter 168 Void Son

"Is this the Void Palace?"

Murmuring, Lu Daosheng looked at the magnificent palace in front of him with a hint of interest.

This is the Void Palace, one of the five Order Palaces.

The other four palaces are the Spacetime Palace, the Cause and Effect Palace, the Fate Palace, and the Samsara Palace.

However, Lu Daosheng did not come here for fun this time.

Boom!

Lu Daosheng stomped his feet fiercely, and in an instant, a terrifying aura surged out of his body.

Boom!

At this moment, the entire Void Palace began to tremble wildly.

"How dare you!"

"Who dares to come to my Void Palace to act wild!!"

Countless powerful auras rose from the Void Palace and then came to the outside of the palace.

Looking at the masters of the Void Palace, Lu Daosheng did not show any fear on his face, but instead showed a sneer.

"Call your Void Palace Master!"

Lu Daosheng shouted coldly.

Seeing Lu Daosheng so arrogant, the masters of the Void Palace suddenly looked ugly.

"How dare you not take my Void Palace seriously, you are looking for death!"

A person from the Void Palace with a strong aura rushed directly towards Lu Daosheng.

Judging from his expression, he must teach Lu Daosheng a lesson.

Seeing this, everyone became a little excited.

"Hahaha, it's the left protector!"

"Humph, this guy is finished, he dared to provoke my Void Palace."

Everyone looked at Lu Daosheng with gloating, as if they would see Lu Daosheng being humiliated in the next moment.

However, the result was not satisfactory.

Lu Daosheng had no expression on his face, just casually waved his hand.

Boom!

Suddenly, the powerful left protector of the Void Palace was blown away and lay flat in the void and lost consciousness.

At this moment, the entire void was completely quiet.

"This, how is this possible."

Everyone's eyes were filled with disbelief. That was the guardian of the Void Palace.

His strength was second only to the Palace Master of the Void Palace.

However, facing the strange man in front of him, he couldn't even take a single blow.

"I'll say it one last time, call your Palace Master!"

Lu Daosheng's tone became even colder.

At this moment, everyone finally realized how terrifying Lu Daosheng was.

As Lu Daosheng stepped forward, everyone began to retreat unconsciously.

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng stopped.

I saw that a middle-aged man appeared in front of Lu Daosheng at some point.

"Palace Master!"

Seeing the middle-aged man, everyone in the Void Palace was immediately excited.

The person who came was the Palace Master of the Void Palace.

Xuwuzi.

"Who are you?"

Facing Lu Daosheng, Xuwuzi was not angry, but calmly asked Lu Daosheng's identity.

Looking at the Palace Master of the Void Palace in front of him.

Lu Daosheng said calmly, "Who I am is not important. Do you know why I came to your Void Palace?"

Xuwuzi took a deep breath and said slowly: "But I am a person from the Void Palace. What did I do to annoy you?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled.

As expected of the Lord of the Void Palace, he is indeed a smart man.

Otherwise, he would not be able to manage this huge Void Palace.

Seeing Lu Daosheng's reaction, Xuwuzi sighed in his heart. At this moment, he had some guesses.

But even so, he still had a fluke mentality.

"I don't know who this Taoist friend is from the Void Palace and what he did. As the Lord of the Void Palace, I will definitely uphold justice."

As soon as these words came out, everyone in the Void Palace fell silent.

At this moment, even a fool knew what was going on.

Even the Lord of the Palace has been humble, isn't it clear what the other party's strength is?

All of a sudden, everyone's face was a little ugly.

In the crowd, Song Yue looked worried.

No, it can't be such a coincidence.

Song Yue began to pray in her heart.

However, after Lu Daosheng spoke, Song Yue's face turned pale.

"Your brother-in-law Song Zhe wants to kill my relatives."

"Moreover, he is secretly cultivating the power of disasters, intending to obtain powerful power from the void."

"I think you should know these things better than me."

Lu Daosheng's words rang out from the scene, and everyone's expressions suddenly became a little shocked.

Song Zhe, the brother-in-law of the master of the Void Palace.

They naturally recognized him.

But I didn't expect that this guy was so dishonest.

The power of disasters is a taboo in order.

And Xu Wuzi's expression also sank.

His brother-in-law is really hurting others and himself.

"How do you want to deal with it?"

Xu Wuzi took a deep breath and said slowly.

Things have already happened, and naturally they cannot be changed.

But what can still be done is to protect their own interests.

As for the brother-in-law, it's no longer his business.

"No!"

At this time, a figure rushed out and came directly to Xu Wuzi's side.

"Azhe will die."

Song Yue pulled Xu Wuzi's wrist, her eyes moist.

Although she was also dissatisfied with what Song Zhe did, Song Zhe was her brother after all.

However, Xu Wuzi had a blank expression on his face, just looking at Lu Daosheng in the distance.

Suddenly, Song Yue reacted.

Then he came directly to Lu Daosheng.

"My lord, I beg you, it's my brother who is ignorant. I have asked him to face the wall and think about it. Please give him a chance."

Song Yue kept begging Lu Daosheng to let his brother go.

Looking at Song Yue in front of him, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

"Let him go? That's impossible."

"There's no chance, of course."

"In fact, you knew what he did a long time ago, but you didn't stop him."

"Now that he has caused trouble and provoked people he shouldn't have provoked, it's too late for you to think about it now."

Lu Daosheng's faint voice sounded.

And Song Yue's figure gradually collapsed.

"No, no,"

Song Yue slumped on the ground, his eyes a little absent-minded.

"Bring Song Zhe up!"

At this time, Xu Wuzi said coldly to his men behind him.

In less than a moment, a young man was brought up.

"Brother-in-law, sister, what happened?"

At this time, Song Zhe had not yet realized the seriousness of the matter.

Seeing his sister Song Yue kneeling on the ground and crying, Song Zhe's face suddenly became ferocious.

"Fuck, who bullied my sister?!"

At this time, Songzhe finally found Lu Daosheng.

"It's you, ant!"

Songzhe shouted angrily, and then rushed directly towards Lu Daosheng.

"Azhe, don't!"

Seeing this, Songyue hurriedly spoke to stop him.

But Songzhe ignored him.

On the side, Xuwuzi, the master of the Void Palace, just watched this scene quietly, without any thoughts of paying attention.

The higher he stood, the more he knew what he really needed.

"Ant, die!"

Songzhe showed a hideous smile.

It seemed that Lu Daosheng would die tragically in his hands in the next moment.

He was extremely angry about the fact that Lu Daosheng crushed one of his incarnations at that time.

What was even more unexpected was that the other party dared to come to the Void Palace.

Although he didn't know how Lu Daosheng came, it didn't matter to him.

The important thing was that he could kill Lu Daosheng.
